beacon.title: Beacon
lines: Build a pyramid of iron, gold, emerald, diamond, or netherite blocks under the beacon to power it.
A bigger pyramid unlocks more effects. Pick one primary effect.
Pay with one accepted ingot: iron, gold, emerald, diamond, or netherite.
At pyramid level 4 you can also pick Regeneration as a second effect.

cartography.title: Cartography Table
lines: Copy a map: a filled map and an empty map.
Zoom out a map: a filled map and paper.
Lock a map so it cannot change: a filled map and a glass pane.
Check the recipe in game if a slot does not accept an item.

grindstone.title: Grindstone
lines: Put two damaged items of the same type in to repair them into one.
Remove enchantments from an item. You get experience back for each one removed.

horse.title: Horse, Donkey, and Mule
lines: Put a saddle in the saddle slot to ride the animal.
Horses take armor in the armor slot.
Donkeys and mules take a chest to gain extra inventory space.

inventory.title: Inventory
lines: The 2x2 grid crafts items. The result slot shows what you can make.
The armor slots on the side hold your helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots.
The off-hand slot holds a second item, such as a shield or a totem.

loom.title: Loom
lines: Put a banner and a dye in the loom to make a new banner design.
A banner pattern in the pattern slot adds a design to the banner.

trade.title: Villager Trading
lines: Pick a trade from the list. Each trade shows what you pay and what you get.
A trade runs out after its uses and restocks as the villager's day goes on.
